name: Prescience

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Golden Path which constrains all possible futures into a single survivable trajectory

VINIT.justification: The state of pure potentiality before the spice trance initiates observation

TANCH.justification: The absolute limit of vision where the observer and the observed become indistinguishable

AFWD.justification: The standard progression of time from cause to effect within the physical universe

AREV.justification: The descent into ancestral data to retrieve patterns that inform future projections

CLINK.justification: The sequential binding of metabolic acceleration to cognitive expansion

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential point where the observer recognizes themselves as the cause of the vision

FSPLIT.justification: A singular event that branches into multiple divergent timelines

FFUSE.justification: The reduction of all probable paths back into the singular experienced reality

EVALT.justification: The identification of a path that ensures the continuity of the species

EVALF.justification: The identification of a path leading to the stagnation or death of the species

ENGAGR.justification: The state of being locked into a future because the act of seeing it has made it inevitable

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of a vision into a historical record that cannot be altered

phase_3.void_description: The state of the non-prescient mind unaware of the branching paths of time
phase_3.true_description: The realization of the intended timeline through active intervention
phase_3.false_description: The failure to navigate the currents of time resulting in unforeseen catastrophe
phase_3.both_description: The paradox of the oracle who sees the future and is simultaneously trapped by its certainty

steps.domain_action: The unawakened mind exists in a state of temporal blindness
The ingestion of melange initiates the metabolic shift
The consciousness descends into the cellular records of the past
The observer identifies the self as the bridge between past and future
The mind projects forward into the immediate causal stream
The vision reaches a nexus where the timeline diverges into possibilities
The oracle identifies the path of the Golden Path
The oracle records the necessity of this path in the collective memory
The multiple visions collapse into the singular chosen action
A secondary branch emerges regarding the cost of the chosen path
The vision reveals the personal suffering required by the oracle
The oracle holds both the necessity of the path and the horror of its cost
The internal conflict resolves into the execution of the vision
The event occurs in physical space and becomes an unchangeable fact of history
The vision concludes at the boundary of the known future

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Bene Gesserit breeding program which prepares the biological hardware for prescient computation
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The spice-saturated blood stream which carries signals between the nervous system and the ancestral memory
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The genetic code and the Other Memory which store the totality of human experience
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The metabolic rate of the observer which dictates the frequency and depth of the visions
phase_5.alfs_store: The Azhar Book and the secret records of the Guild which provide the baseline for temporal navigation

phase_6.cycle_cost: The consumption of melange and the psychological stability of the observer
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A universe of chaotic probability and unknown outcomes
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A universe of determined trajectory and fixed destiny
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The reduction in external uncertainty is balanced by the internal complexity and burden of the oracle
